products.name: IVORY PLEATED TOP
products.description: Ivory satin top featuring a pointed collar, dropped shoulders, and long, relaxed sleeves. Defined by structured vertical pleating at the waist, creating a softly cinched silhouette that contrasts with the fluid drape and subtle sheen of the satin fabric. Finished with tonal buttons and a gently flared hem.

products.name: FUCHSIA MINK JACKET
products.description: Fuchsia mink fur jacket featuring a voluminous silhouette, round neckline, and three-quarter-length sleeves. Crafted with a richly textured fur exterior, tonal lining, and concealed front closure. Finished with a cropped length and softly structured shape.

products.name: RODEO OVERSIZED SUEDE TRENCH COAT
products.description: Full-length double-breasted trench coat cut from velvety cognac-espresso calf suede with storm flaps, belted cuffs, and an exaggerated storm collar.

products.name: LE CITY CONCAVE TOP-HANDLE BAG
products.description: Curvilinear sculptural base crafted from high-gloss box cow leather in deep oxblood crimson with aged brass SAMO monogram hardware and removable crossbody strap.

products.name: WINTER 26 OPERA COCOON FUR COAT
products.description: High-volume enveloping winter coat featuring dense plush shearling-fur texture, concealed hook closures, and a silk satin interior.

products.name: ARC TROUSERS
products.description: Mint green high-waisted trousers featuring a double-pleated front, wide-leg silhouette, and structured waistband with a matching adjustable belt. Designed with a concealed front fastening and softly draped fabric that falls into a fluid, full-length shape. Finished with clean, tailored hems.

products.name: TRACK MONOLITH PIPED LEATHER PANTS
products.description: Relaxed athletic silhouette reimagined in supple nappa cow leather with contrast ivory side piping and zippered ankle gussets.

products.name: ASYMMETRIC DRAPED SUEDE MAXI SKIRT
products.description: Column maxi skirt featuring an architectural wrap waist, raw-edge laser hemline, and satin-backed interior for fluid movement.

products.name: COUTURE RING SELVEDGE BAGGY DENIM
products.description: 15oz Japanese indigo ring-spun denim treated with an artisanal charcoal overwash and embossed cow leather back waist plaque.

products.name: BLUE KNIT
products.description: Light blue fine-knit sweater with a relaxed silhouette, wide round neckline, dropped shoulders, and long sleeves finished with ribbed cuffs. Softly textured fabric with a natural, effortless drape.

products.name: IVORY & MINT SET
products.description: Two-piece set featuring an ivory satin top with a pointed collar, button-front closure, long sleeves, and structured waist pleating. Paired with mint green high-waisted trousers featuring double front pleats, a wide-leg silhouette, and a matching adjustable belt.

products.name: ARCHIVES DOUBLE-RING COW LEATHER BELT
products.description: 40mm full-grain bridle cow leather strap finished with sculptural interlocking brushed-gold rings inspired by the house archive.

products.name: PETIT ATELIER CASHMERE & COTTON KNIT
products.description: Featherweight knitted cardigan crafted from combed organic cotton and Inner Mongolian cashmere for ages 1 to 5.

products.name: CHILDREN SPORT CHIC LEATHER & WOOL BOMBER
products.description: Varsity-proportioned children 6+ jacket with brushed Melton wool body, supple cow leather sleeves, and ribbed storm cuffs.

products.name: TEEN RUNWAY SUEDE & SELVEDGE DENIM JEANS
products.description: Architectural teen 13+ silhouette in raw Japanese selvedge denim with suede trim and wide-cut carpenter tailoring.

products.name: ATELIER SHEARLING COLLAR SUEDE JACKET
products.description: Tailored suede outerwear for children 6+ with plush shearling collar and brushed palladium snap closures.
